entities.name: Fascism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The far-right authoritarian political movement (1919–1945) characterized by dictatorial power, forcible suppression of opposition, and ultranationalism. Originating in Italy under Mussolini and reaching its apex in Nazi Germany, it led to World War II.
